name: billcall
description: What AI costs a company, counted from one dated price table: the monthly bill of a mix of seats, API work and own machines with the price of one accepted task; the week's spend from Claude Code's logs, the Team spend report and OpenTelemetry, with idle seats; budget alarms at 50, 80 and 100 per cent; Team against Enterprise; contract rates as a modelPricing block for managed settings; an own GPU machine against renting. It counts and compares - it buys nothing and never asks for a card.
